statement: Let (R, m) → (S, n) be a flat local map of complete Noetherian local rings. Suppose R is a domain, dim R = dim S = d > 0, the residue characteristic is p > 0, and the residue field L of S is algebraically closed. There is a factorization R −→ (T, t) −→ S = T/J with the following properties. Write b = dim(T/mT) and h = d + b. (i) The ring T is complete, its residue field is L, and R → T is flat with regular closed fiber. Moreover dim T = h and e(T) = e(R). (ii) Every irreducible component of T has dimension h. The ideal J is perfect of grade b, and S has a minimal finite free T-resolution P• in degrees 0, . . . , b with P0 = T. (iii) Choose lifts x1, . . . , xd ∈ t of a minimal reduction of n. Then F• = P• ⊗T K•(x1, . . . , xd; T) is a finite free complex in degrees 0, . . . , h, has F0 = T, and is contractible locally on Spec T \ {t}. Its differential entries lie in t, and its ranks have alternating sum zero. 21 (iv) If Q ∈ Spec T contracts to zero in R, then TQ is a complete intersection. In mixed charac- teristic, TQ is regular. Every prime of T which is minimal over J contracts to zero in R. In mixed characteristic T is generically reduced; a prime Q minimal over J contains a unique minimal prime of T.
